_doc: Demo video cut, read by scripts/video/assemble.py. Clip and image paths are relative to --src (the footage folder from ADR 0019). dur = scene length in seconds; speed > 1 plays faster and the scene's label says so; lines = [narration line, seconds after the scene starts]. crop = [w, h, x, y] in clip pixels. Kinds: zoom = the crop of a clip in a framed panel with one large sentence (side) beside it; still = the same for an image, slowly zooming to zoomTo around focus [x, y] (0..1); wide = the crop scaled to the full frame (16:9 crops only); title = the closing card drawn from 'closing'.

silence._doc: No narration for minSecs or more counts as silence (ffmpeg silencedetect at noiseDb on the finished file).

freeze._doc: A picture that does not change for minSecs (ffmpeg freezedetect at noiseDb) is a frozen scene.

liveFootage._doc: Footage filmed on the public site by e2e/tests/film-live.spec.ts (E2E_VIDEO + E2E_FILM_LIVE, English UI). typeDelayMs = pause between typed keys; holdSecs = seconds held on each moment so the cut has room; examplePaths = the finished /contoh paths shown, the last one has its first public record opened; countdownFromTop = where the demo countdown is held, as a share of the screen height from the top. live-run.json in the footage folder keeps the card link and the demo transactions for the explorer shots (explorerFootage.liveShots).

explorerFootage._doc: Explorer footage filmed by e2e/tests/film-explorer.spec.ts (E2E_VIDEO + E2E_EXPLORER, Chromium project) from the run in config/examples.json. tx = [path, step] in that file; address = a key of that file. Each stop scrolls to the heading with exactly that name ('heading') or the first element containing that text ('text'); neither = stay where the page is; the target lands marginPx below the top, clear of the explorer's sticky tab bar. Then it holds for 'hold' seconds.
explorerFootage._liveShotsDoc: liveShots film transactions from the last live recording (<E2E_VIDEO>/live-run.json from film-live.spec.ts): run = which demo scene, step = index into its steps (-1 = the payout, the last one), like = the shot whose stops it reuses. Skipped when that file is absent.

narration._doc: Line lengths of the narration this cut is timed against (narration.json in the voice folder). build refuses a voice whose lines differ by more than toleranceSecs.
